headline: Review of applications for 68 Fairfield Avenue and 48 Fairfield Avenue.
summary: Officer elections come first. The new commission will also hear a presentation from PVPC, with questions and answers, and set its regular meeting times and tasks.
items: Election of chair and vice-chair from among the members
Election of secretary, from inside or outside the members
Old business: review of 68 Fairfield Avenue application
Orientation: presentation by PVPC with questions and answers
Setting regular meeting times and locations
Identifying regular commission tasks, procedures, and support
location: Room 6, City Hall (Old Tax Collector's Office), 20 Korean Veterans Plaza, Holyoke, MA 01040-5086
